attachment_binding_check.name: attachment_binding_check
attachment_binding_check.value: ("attachment"."message_id" is null and "attachment"."ordinal" is null) or ("attachment"."message_id" is not null and "attachment"."ordinal" is not null)

command_operation_read_slot_check.name: command_operation_read_slot_check
command_operation_read_slot_check.value: ("command_operation"."access" = 'exclusive' and "command_operation"."read_slot" is null) or ("command_operation"."access" = 'read' and (("command_operation"."state" in ('queued', 'completed', 'failed') and "command_operation"."read_slot" is null) or ("command_operation"."read_slot" is not null and "command_operation"."read_slot" between 1 and 4)))
